features.name: Improved Body
features.descriptionEn: At 7th level, your body has adapted to your training. Your jump distance is multiplied by your Strength modifier, and your carrying capacity (including maximum load and maximum lift) is doubled.
features.description: Tại cấp 7, cấu trúc xương và cơ bắp thích nghi đạt tới sức mạnh quái vật: cự ly nhảy xa và nhảy cao của bạn được nhân thẳng với Strength modifier; đồng thời tải trọng mang vác và sức nâng tối đa của bạn được nhân đôi.

features.name: Resistant
features.descriptionEn: At 7th level, your physical and mental conditioning has made you resistant to effects. When you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw, and only half damage if you fail. At 14th and 20th level, you choose one additional saving throw.
features.description: Tại cấp 7, phản xạ thể chất phi phàm bảo vệ bạn khỏi các thảm họa hủy diệt: khi chịu một hiệu ứng yêu cầu DEX Save để giảm nửa sát thương, bạn hoàn toàn KHÔNG nhận sát thương nếu Save thành công, và chỉ nhận một nửa sát thương nếu thất bại. Tại cấp 14 và cấp 20, bạn được chọn thêm một loại Saving Throw nữa để nhận đặc quyền né tránh tương tự.

features.name: Weapon Specialist
features.descriptionEn:
At 9th level, as the time passes you have learned how to use the maximum potential of your weapons. You can roll one additional weapon damage die when determining the extra damage for a critical hit with a melee attack.

This increases to two additional dice at 13th level and three additional dice at 17th level.
features.description:
Tại cấp 9, bạn khai phóng trọn vẹn 100% uy lực sát thương của mọi loại Chú Cụ trong tay: bạn được đổ thêm một xúc xắc sát thương vũ khí khi tính sát thương bạo kích của một đòn Critical Hit cận chiến.

Mức bạo kích này tăng lên thành 2 xúc xắc cộng thêm tại cấp 13, và đạt tới 3 xúc xắc cộng thêm tại cấp 17.

features.name: Celestial Body
features.vietnameseName: Thần Thể Bất Xâm (Lãnh Địa Bất Nhiễm)
features.descriptionEn:
At 10th level, your body is like a divine object none shall harm, not even god itself. You cannot be targeted by the sure hit effect of a Domain Expansion, and cannot be detected by one while inside one. (Ex: If you are trapped inside a domain that forces you to make a Constitution saving throw as its sure hit, you won't have to make the saving throw.)

You can also freely pass through magical barriers of any kind, suffering no ill effects for doing so.

This, however, doesn’t work on sure-hit effects which target objects, or creatures without cursed energy, such as Malevolent Shrine.
features.description:
Tại cấp 10, vì hoàn toàn không có một tia Chú lực nào (0 CE), cơ thể bạn được quy tắc thế giới coi như một 'vật thể vô cơ' tự nhiên: bạn HOÀN TOÀN MIỄN NHIỄM trước hiệu ứng Đòn Đánh Tất Trúng (Sure-Hit) của Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa, và kết giới lãnh địa hoàn toàn không thể phát hiện hay định vị bạn (bạn không bao giờ phải thực hiện Saving Throw nếu đó là đòn Sure-Hit của Lãnh Địa).

• Phá vỡ rào chắn: Bạn có thể tự do đi xuyên qua mọi bức Màn hay rào chắn kết giới ma pháp mà không phải chịu bất kỳ lực cản trở nào.
• Lưu ý: Năng lực này không bảo vệ bạn trước các đòn Sure-Hit nhắm vào đồ vật vô cơ hoặc thực thể không chú lực (điển hình như Phục Ma Ngự Thai Tử - Malevolent Shrine của Sukuna chém nát vạn vật bằng Giải - Dismantle).

features.name: Improved Fighting Style
features.vietnameseName: Phong Cách Sát Thủ Thượng Thừa
features.descriptionEn:
At 14th level, with years of training you have developed improved versions of your fighting style. Whenever you use any of your fighting styles, they instead give the benefits down below:

• Improved Archery: +3 bonus to attack rolls made with ranged weapons.
• Improved Blind Fighting: Blindsight 30 feet.
• Improved Dueling: +3 bonus to damage rolls with a single weapon.
• Improved Great Weapon Fighting: Reroll 1, 2, or 3 on damage dice.
• Improved Grappler: Deal 1d8 bludgeoning damage to grappled creature.
• Improved Interception: Reaction reduce damage by 1d12 + PB.
• Improved Protection: Reaction impose disadvantage within 10 feet.
• Improved Two-Weapon Fighting: Add ability modifier + 1 to off-hand damage.
• Improved Tunnel Fighter: Opportunity attacks without reaction; +1 bonus to attacks and damage rolls made this way.
features.description:
Tại cấp 14, kỹ nghệ vũ khí của bạn đạt tới cảnh giới đăng phong tạo cực. Trường phái chiến đấu của bạn được nâng cấp uy lực:

• Improved Archery: +3 vào đòn tấn công tầm xa.
• Improved Blind Fighting: Tầm Nhìn Mù (Blindsight) mở rộng lên tới 30 ft.
• Improved Dueling: +3 sát thương khi cầm một vũ khí một tay duy nhất.
• Improved Great Weapon Fighting: Đổ lại xúc xắc sát thương ra 1, 2 hoặc 3 trên vũ khí hai tay.
• Improved Grappler: Gây 1d8 sát thương đập mỗi đầu lượt lên kẻ bị Grapple.
• Improved Interception: Reaction giảm 1d12 + PB sát thương cho đồng đội.
• Improved Protection: Reaction áp Disadvantage trong cự ly mở rộng 10 ft.
• Improved Two-Weapon Fighting: Cộng điểm thuộc tính + 1 vào sát thương tay phụ.
• Improved Tunnel Fighter: Tung đòn cơ hội không tốn Reaction, đồng thời nhận thêm +1 vào đòn đánh và sát thương.

features.name: Demigod's Figure
features.vietnameseName: Tố Chất Bán Thần (Thấu Thị Linh Hồn)
features.descriptionEn:
At 15th level, your body is almost reaching its peak. You can hold your breath for twice as long, suffocate for twice as long without dropping to 0 hit points, you can go twice as long without food and water, and exhaustion from food and water deprivation takes twice as long to occur. In addition, you require twice as many levels of exhaustion before suffering the penalties (for example, if you have one level of exhaustion, you do not suffer the normal penalty until you have 2 levels).

You can also perceive the souls of objects when effects or features call for such.
features.description:
Tại cấp 15, thân thể bạn đạt tới cảnh giới bán thần vượt khỏi mọi giới hạn sinh học: bạn nín thở lâu gấp đôi, chịu ngạt thở lâu gấp đôi trước khi rơi về 0 HP, nhịn đói khát lâu gấp đôi và tích lũy kiệt sức chậm gấp đôi. Bạn cần số bậc Kiệt Sức (Exhaustion) gấp đôi mới phải chịu hình phạt (ví dụ: bị 1 bậc kiệt sức sẽ không bị phạt cho đến khi tích đủ 2 bậc).

Đặc biệt: Ngũ giác của bạn nhạy bén đến mức có thể cảm nhận và Nhận Thức Linh Hồn của Đồ Vật Vô Cơ (Perceive the souls of objects), cho phép bạn chém xuyên qua mật độ vật chất và phát huy uy lực tối thượng của các bảo khí như Thích Hồn Đao (Soul Splitter Katana).

features.name: God of War
features.descriptionEn:
Finally at 20th level, your supernatural body reaches its pinnacle. Your Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution scores increase by +4 each. You also gain the following benefits:

• Inevitable Triumph: Once per long rest when reduced to 0 hit points, you can choose to remain at 1 hit point. Additionally, you gain resistance to all non-magical damage and immunity to non-magical bludgeoning, slashing and piercing damage.
• Ultimate Mastery: You have mastered every aspect of combat. You gain proficiency in all saving throws and have advantage on all ability checks related to Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution.
• Eternal Vigor: You ignore the detriments of age and stay in your physical prime. You become immune to any effects that age you magically.
features.description:
Tại cấp 20, thể xác Thiên Dữ Chú Phược đạt tới đỉnh phong thần thánh tuyệt đối, một hiện thân của chiến thần sát phạt khiến cả giới Chú thuật lẫn Nguyền hồn phải run rẩy. Cả ba chỉ số Strength, Dexterity, và Constitution của bạn tăng vĩnh viễn thêm +4 mỗi chỉ số. Đồng thời bạn nhận các đặc quyền:

• Khải Hoàn Bất Tử (Inevitable Triumph): Một lần mỗi Long Rest khi bị đánh tụt về 0 HP, bạn có thể chọn giữ lại 1 HP. Ngoài ra, bạn nhận Kháng (Resistance) với mọi sát thương phi ma thuật, và Miễn Nhiễm (Immunity) HOÀN TOÀN trước sát thương đập, chém, đâm phi ma thuật.
• Đăng Phong Tạo Cực (Ultimate Mastery): Tinh thông vạn biến: bạn nhận Proficiency cho TẤT CẢ các loại Saving Throws, và nhận Advantage đối với mọi lần kiểm tra thuộc tính liên quan đến Strength, Dexterity, và Constitution.
• Sinh Lực Bất Diệt (Eternal Vigor): Bạn rũ bỏ mọi sự suy thoái của thời gian, vĩnh viễn ở trạng thái thể chất sung mãn nhất của cuộc đời và miễn nhiễm hoàn toàn với mọi hiệu ứng ma pháp gây lão hóa.

hpHigher: 1d12 (or 7) + CON modifier per Heavenly Restriction level after 1st

profData.skills: Choose two from Acrobatics, Athletics, Insight, Intimidation, Perception, Stealth, and Survival

coreFeatures.name: Restrained Body
coreFeatures.description:
Starting at 1st level, your body is simply built differently than others. You have supernatural strength, speed and durability. You gain the following traits:

Supernatural Body. You gain a +2 in your Strength, Dexterity and Constitution scores. These same scores increase by +1 at 5th, 9th, 13th and 17th level. In addition, your ability score limit is increased to 25. At every level you gain after 1st, your ability score maximum increases by 1, up to 40.

Supernatural Resilience. Your unarmored AC equals 10 + your Constitution modifier + your Dexterity modifier.

Perfect Health. You have advantage on saving throws against disease and the poisoned condition.

Supernatural Vision. You gain proficiency in the Perception skill, or expertise if already proficient.

Pure Body. Your body has no traces of any kinds of mystical energy, meaning you can't multiclass or learn about magic or cursed energy, and if you somehow have abilities which use magic or cursed energy, you lose them. You cannot land black flashes or utilize RCT.

coreFeatures.name: Unarmored Movement
coreFeatures.description:
Also at 1st level, your speed increases by 20 feet while you are not wearing armor or wielding a shield. This bonus increases when you reach certain Heavenly Restriction levels, as shown in the Heavenly Restriction table.

In addition, you gain the ability to move and run along vertical surfaces and across liquids on your turn without falling during the move.

coreFeatures.name: Martial Arts
coreFeatures.description:
Also at 1st level, your practice of martial arts gives you mastery of combat styles that use unarmed strikes and martial weapons.

You can use Dexterity instead of Strength for the attack and damage rolls of your unarmed strikes and martial weapons.

You can roll a d6 in place of the normal damage of your unarmed strike or martial weapon. This die changes as you gain Heavenly Restriction levels, as shown in the Martial Arts column of the Heavenly Restriction table.

When you use the Attack action with an unarmed strike or a martial weapon on your turn, you can make one unarmed strike or weapon attack as a bonus action (For example, if you take the Attack action and attack with a quarterstaff, you can also make an unarmed strike as a bonus action, assuming you haven't already taken a bonus action this turn.).

coreFeatures.name: Body Improvements
coreFeatures.description: At 2nd level, your body is constantly growing and improving, becoming better by the day. You have a number of body points equal to your Heavenly Restriction level. These points can be used to obtain body improvements, all listed down at the Body Improvements List section. You cannot change an improvement once chosen.

coreFeatures.name: Fighting Style
coreFeatures.description:
At 2nd level, due to your training and constant improving body, you have a newfound ability when wielding weapons. You can choose one of the fighting styles bellow:

Archery (PHB). You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls you make with ranged weapons.

Blind Fighting (TCE). You have blindsight with a range of 10 feet. Within that range, you can effectively see anything that isn't behind total cover, even if you're blinded or in darkness. Moreover, you can see an invisible creature within that range, unless the creature successfully hides from you.

Dueling (PHB). When you are wielding a melee weapon in one hand and no other weapons, you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls with that weapon.

Great Weapon Fighting (PHB). When you roll a 1 or 2 on a damage die for an attack you make with a melee weapon that you are wielding with two hands, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll, even if the new roll is a 1 or a 2. The weapon must have the two-handed or versatile property for you to gain this benefit.

Grappler. At the start of each of your turns, you can deal 1d4 bludgeoning damage to one creature grappled by you.

Interception (TCE). When a creature you can see hits a target, other than you, within 5 feet of you with an attack, you can use your reaction to reduce the damage the target takes by 1d10 + your proficiency bonus (to a minimum of 0 damage). You must be wielding a shield or a simple or martial weapon to use this reaction.

Protection (PHB). When a creature you can see attacks a target other than you that is within 5 feet of you, you can use your reaction to impose disadvantage on the attack roll.

Two-Weapon Fighting (PHB). When you engage in two-weapon fighting, you can add your ability modifier to the damage of the second attack.

Tunnel Fighter (UA). As a bonus action, you can enter a defensive stance that lasts until the start of your next turn. While in your defensive stance, you can make opportunity attacks without using your reaction, and you can use your reaction to make a melee attack against a creature that moves more than 5 feet while within your reach.

coreFeatures.name: Ideal
coreFeatures.description: At 3rd level, due to bad life experiences, you have acquired an ideal. Choose between Prideful or Vengeful, both detailed at the end of the class description. Your choice grants you features at 3rd and again at 9th, 13th and 17th level.

coreFeatures.name: Ability Score Improvement
coreFeatures.description: When you reach 4th level, and again at 6th, 8th, 12th, 16th and 19th level, you can increase one ability score of your choice by 3, or you can increase three ability scores of your choice by 1. You can't increase an ability score above your ability score limit using this feature. You can also ignore this increase to instead gain a Feat.

coreFeatures.name: Extra Attack
coreFeatures.description: At 5th level, you can now attack twice instead of once when you take the attack action. This increases to three times instead of twice at 11th level. It increases to four times at 18th level, and to five times at 20th level.

coreFeatures.name: Improved Body
coreFeatures.description:
At 7th level, the longer you live the more you'll realize your body has no limits. You gain +4 to your Strength, Dexterity and Constitution scores. You gain proficiency in Dexterity saving throws.

In addition, you gain immunity to disease and the poisoned condition and resistance to poison damage.

coreFeatures.name: Resistant
coreFeatures.description:
At 7th level, your newfound abilities and body has allowed you to resist certain area effects, such as a blue dragon’s lightning breath or a fireball spell. Choose one of the following ability scores:

Brawn - Strength

Evasion - Dexterity

Endurance - Constitution

Discernment - Intelligence

Intuition - Wisdom

Ego - Charisma

When you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a saving throw of the chosen ability to only take half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw, and only half damage if you fail. At 14th and 20th level, you choose one additional saving throw.

coreFeatures.name: Weapon Specialist
coreFeatures.description:
At 9th level, as the time passes you have learned how to use the maximum potential of your weapons. You can roll one additional weapon damage die when determining the extra damage for a critical hit with a melee attack.

This increases to two additional dice at 13th level and three additional dice at 17th level.

ideals.title: Lý Tưởng (Ideal - Cấp 3)
ideals.description: Tại Cấp 3, do trải nghiệm sống và sự đối xử của giới chú thuật, bạn lựa chọn một Lý tưởng định hình con đường chiến đấu: Kiêu Hãnh (Prideful - phong cách Toji) hoặc Báo Thù (Vengeful - phong cách Maki).

subclasses.name: Prideful (Kẻ Kiêu Hãnh)
subclasses.quote: Mày vừa thua một con khỉ thậm chí không có nổi một chút Chú lực đấy.
subclasses.description: Lập trường kiêu hãnh khinh miệt giới Chú thuật sư, rèn giũa bản lĩnh thợ săn chuyên nghiệp để bóp nghẹt và đè bẹp những kẻ tự phụ mang dòng máu chú thuật.

features.name: Sorcerer Hunter
features.description:
At 3rd level, you have grown a prideful stance against sorcerers, mocking them by saying things like they lost against a primate. You have become a sorcerer hunter, making you gain the following benefits:

When a creature within 5 feet of you uses a Cursed technique, you can use your reaction to make a melee weapon attack against that creature.

When you damage a creature that is concentrating on a spell or a Cursed technique, that creature has disadvantage on the saving throw it makes to maintain its concentration.

You have advantage on saving throws against spells or Cursed techniques cast by creatures within 10 feet of you.

features.name: Fighter's Drive
features.description:
At 9th level, you have a will to fight that drives you beyond your limits, making you go further than what you could normally do for a moment. On your turn, you can take an additional action.

This can only be used once per long rest. You can use this two times per long rest but only once per turn at 18th level.

features.name: All Things I can Handle
features.description: At 13th level, due to being experienced with killing sorcerers, dealing with their techniques has become an easy task for you. Whenever you are targeted by a spell or technique attack roll or saving throw, you learn how it works and adapt to it. After adapting to it, you can use your reaction to gain advantage on the saving throw or force the attack roll to be made at disadvantage.

features.name: You Lost to a Monkey
features.description:
At 17th level, no matter who they are, no matter their tricks, you can be assured of victory. Once per round, you can choose to deal critical damage on a hit.

In addition, whenever you reduce a creature to 0 hit points you gain temporary hit points equal to your level.

Vengeful

People have wronged you in the past, and despite your body healing from the damage caused, the scars in your heart will never heal.

subclasses.name: Vengeful (Kẻ Báo Thù)
subclasses.quote: Tao sẽ phá hủy tất cả mọi thứ.
subclasses.description: Lấp đầy tâm trí bằng cơn thịnh nộ bùng cháy và khao khát tiêu diệt những kẻ đã đày đọa mình, biến sự căm phẫn tột cùng thành sức mạnh hủy diệt không thể ngăn cản.

features.name: Vengeful Fury
features.description:
At 3rd level, you are filled with a deep hatred filled by vengeance, making you ignore everything and let anger consume you. As a bonus action you can enter your fury state if you're not wearing heavy armor, gaining the following benefits:

When you take bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage, you reduce the damage by your proficiency bonus.

You deal one additional dice of damage whenever you score a critical hit with a melee weapon.

Your fury lasts for 1 minute. It ends early if you are knocked unconscious or if your turn ends and you haven't attacked a hostile creature since your last turn or taken damage since then. You can also end your rage state on your turn as a bonus action.

You can enter your fury a number of times up to your proficiency bonus, and recover all uses upon a short or long rest.

features.name: Bloodlust
features.description:
At 9th level, you have immense bloodlust for those who have wronged you, even making it your personal task to hunt them down. You can choose one creature that you can see that has damaged you or an ally. For 1 minute, your weapon attacks against that creature gain a +1 to Critical Range, deal one additional dice of damage, and whenever you score a critical hit you can knock them prone.

You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you recover all uses upon taking a long rest.

features.name: Immense Anger
features.description:
At 13th level, your rage is growing deeper, making you feel almost invincible. When you enter your fury, you gain the following benefits:

When you take bludgeoning, piercing or slashing damage, the damage is decreased by twice your proficiency bonus.

You deal two additional damage dice when you score a critical hit with a melee weapon.

features.name: Follow Your Wrath
features.description:
At 17th level, you learned that nothing but your hatred against those that wronged you matters, and no one will stop you from going after them. When you enter your fury, you gain the following benefits:

You gain further damage reduction equal to half your level(rounded up) that applies to all damage types.

You deal three additional dice of damage whenever you score a critical hit with a melee weapon.

Body Improvements

Strength Improvements

You can have a number of these improvements equal to your Strength modifier.

bodyImprovements.title: Kho Cải Tiến Cơ Thể (Body Improvements List)
bodyImprovements.description: Tại Cấp 2, cơ thể bạn không ngừng đột biến và tiến hóa. Bạn nhận được số Điểm Cơ Thể (Body Points) bằng với cấp độ Heavenly Restriction. Các điểm này dùng để mở khóa các nâng cấp thể chất vĩnh viễn không thể thay đổi.

items.name: Superhuman Might
items.description: Your strength is beyond that of even trained martial artists. You count as one size larger for the purposes of grappling, shoving, disarming, and the weight you can carry, push, drag or lift.

items.name: Strong Leap
items.description: Your leg strength has become truly monstrous. Whenever you jump, you can triple your jump height or distance.

items.name: Strength Technique
items.description:
Upon selecting this body improvement, you gain 1 Physical Feat of your choice with prerequisites you meet.

You can take this body improvement multiple times however you can only select at certain levels in this class. These levels are 2nd, 5th, 11th, and 17th level.

Speed Improvements

You feel like you could probably win against a special grade in a race due to how fast you are now.

You can have a number of these improvements equal to your Dexterity modifier.

items.name: Monstrous Might
items.description: Your body strength is increasing by the second, you could even be called a monster at this point. You now count as two sizes larger for the purposes of grappling, shoving, disarming, and the weight you can carry, push, drag or lift. In addition, your martial arts die increases by 1 dice, applying after die tier increases.

items.name: Godly Might
items.description: You are the pinnacle of strength, some even consider you as athletic as an ancient god. You now count as three sizes larger for the purposes of grappling, shoving, disarming, and the weight you can carry, push, drag or lift and your martial arts die increases by 1 dice again, applying after die tier increases. In addition, you now deal twice as much damage to structures and objects.

items.name: Destructive Force
items.description: You learn to better apply your godlike strength into your strikes, creating thunderous shockwaves. When you hit a creature with a weapon attack using strength, compare the attack roll result to the AC of every creature of your choice within 20 feet of the target other than the target. If the attack roll would hit, you deal half the damage of the attack(rounded down) to the creatures that were hit.

items.name: Sonic Speed
items.description: Your speed has increased dramatically. Your movement speed doubles and you can take the Dash action as a bonus action.

items.name: Supersonic Reflexes
items.description: You gain an additional reaction per round. You can use your reaction to grant yourself advantage on a Dexterity check you make.

items.name: Sight Speed
items.description: You have become so fast, people blink and you're already in front of them. Your movement speed doubles once again, and opportunity attacks against you are made with disadvantage due to your speed.

items.name: Lighting Reflexes
items.description:
You gain one more reaction per round. You can also use your reaction to gain advantage on checks based on an ability score you choose from the following; Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma when you gain this body improvement. This choice cannot be changed later on.

Durability Improvements

You're like a wall that cannot be moved, not even the hardest of blows will bring you down.

You can have a number of these improvements equal to your Constitution modifier.

items.name: Light Speed
items.description: You have become faster than people can even perceive, seemingly approaching even the speed of light. Your movement speed doubles again, and creatures cannot perceive you moving, thus creatures can’t take reactions in response to your movement unless they have blindsight.

items.name: Hardened Skin
items.description: Your skin has hardened, becoming more akin to bone. You gain +2 maximum hit points per level that you have, and you gain +2 more for every level you gain thereafter.

items.name: Iron Skin
items.description: Your skin has further hardened, becoming more like steel than flesh. You gain +2 more maximum hit points per level, and you take 3 less damage from non-magical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing.

items.name: Adamantine Skin
items.description:
Your skin has even further hardened, becoming more like adamantine. You add your constitution modifier an additional time when calculating your maximum hit points per level, and the damage reduction you gained from Iron Skin now applies to all bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

Mind Improvements

Your body has increased both physically and mentally.

You can have a number of these improvements equal to your Wisdom modifier.

items.name: Minor Precognition
items.description: You have a minor sense of how to read your opponents, giving you a small advantage in battle. You gain a +5 to your passive perception, and unseen attacks are not rolled with advantage against you.

items.name: Minor Enhanced Senses
items.description: You do not need to have your eyes open to see, your instincts are enough. You gain blindsight to a range of 10ft. Within that range, you can effectively see anything that isn't behind total cover, even if you're blinded or in darkness. Moreover, you can see an invisible creature within that range, unless the creature successfully hides from you. If you have blindsight, the range increases by 10ft.

items.name: Precognition
items.description: Your precognition is getting better, now being able to even predict what your opponents will do. You cannot be surprised while conscious, and you have advantage on Dexterity saving throws against an effect you can see, such as traps or spells. You can't receive this benefit if you're blinded, deafened or incapacitated.

items.name: Medium Enhanced Senses
items.description: Your senses have been enhanced even more, your instincts have been getting better. Your blindsight increases by 20ft. In addition, you gain 30ft of tremorsense.

items.name: Major Precognition
items.description: Your precognition has evolved to the point you're almost seeing the future. Once per round, when a creature targets you for an attack, you can use your reaction to force their attack rolls against you to be made at disadvantage until the beginning of your next turn. Additionally, once per round you can give yourself advantage against one saving throw.

items.name: Major Enhanced Senses
items.description: Your senses have reached their peak. Your blindsight increases again by 60ft and your tremorsense range increases to 60ft. You gain advantage in Wisdom (Perception) checks involving hearing.

pactTraits.desc: Thể chất đanh thép không cần giáp trụ hay khiên, kháng cự mọi đòn đánh vật lý bọc Chú lực.

pactTraits.title: Trần Chỉ Số Phi Nhân Loại (Max Stat Cap)
pactTraits.desc: Phá vỡ giới hạn 20 của người thường. Cấp 1 trần 25, mỗi cấp tăng thêm +1 lên kịch trần 40!

pactTraits.title: Thăng Tiến Thuộc Tính Tự Động
pactTraits.desc: Cơ thể tự hoàn thiện qua tu luyện mà không cần tiêu tốn lượt Tăng điểm thuộc tính (ASI).

pactTraits.title: Vô Hình & Miễn Nhiễm Lãnh Địa (Pure Body)
pactTraits.desc: Hoàn toàn 0 Chú Lực. Vô hình trước giác quan Chú thuật, kết giới xem như vô tri và miễn nhiễm đòn Tất Trúng.

pactTraits.title: Sức Khỏe Hoàn Hảo (Perfect Health)
pactTraits.desc: Luôn có Lợi Thế (Advantage) đối với mọi Saving Throw chống lại Bệnh tật và Trạng thái Nhiễm độc.

bodyPointsRules.retraining: Mỗi khi thăng cấp độ mới trong class này, bạn có thể hoán đổi 1 Cải tiến cơ thể đã học lấy 1 Cải tiến khác đủ điều kiện.
